title: Roller coaster Road 🚷
content: Here’s another example of a strange reoccurring dream that I feel id related to mallworld, but i’m not completely sure. Normally I’m running down this road at full speed even through the loops without falling while these mannequin looking figures and black suits with sunglasses are chasing me and there’s waves crashing in on the sides of the road almost as if it’s going to flood, but it never does this is just another case where I’m curious if anyone else has had this dream or had similar dreams and if you guys think it’s related to mallworld.
